_doc: Layout of the PPU graphics presets table of fCore_ManageGraphicsPresets (src/code/bank_80/core.asm, Table_<REG>_Presets): the 24 register tables of `count` bytes each follow each other from `address` in the order of `registers`. The comment lines are written at the top of assets/gfx/presets.csv.
header: Graphics presets (index = byte 0 of an area graphics descriptor, assets/areas/area_gfx.json; fCore_ManageGraphicsPresets in src/code/bank_80/core.asm).
One row per preset, one column per PPU register the preset sets:
OBSEL $2101 object size / name base   BGMODE $2105 BG mode / tile size   BG1SC..BG4SC $2107-$210A name table VRAM address (bits 7-2 = word address / $400) + size
BG12NBA $210B / BG34NBA $210C character base addresses (4 bits per BG)   TM/TS $212C/$212D main / sub screen layers   TMW/TSW $212E/$212F window masks
CGWSEL $2130 / CGADSUB $2131 colour math   SETINI $2133   W12SEL $2123 / W34SEL $2124 / WOBJSEL $2125 window settings   WH0..WH3 $2126-$2129 window positions
Generated into build/gen/tables/gfx_presets.asm (Table_<REG>_Presets, one db per preset) by tools/gfx/presets.py.
